Kathy ElKamouny

A Massachusetts native, Kathy has lived and painted on Cape Cod for more than 10 years. Watercolor is her favorite medium, but she is now exploring acrylics. In addition to Harwich’s guild, Kathy is a member of the Cape Cod Art Association and the Creative Arts Center in Chatham. Her paintings are on display in private and corporate collections in this country as well as England, Canada, France, Germany, and Egypt.

Kathy’s paintings are on exhibit at The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists in Harwich Port, the guild’s gallery on Route 28. During the summer, you can meet Kathy and see more of her paintings at the Art in The Park shows at Doane Park in Harwich Port.

Represented on Cape Cod by:
The Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists (source page unavailable), 551 Route 28, Harwich Port, MA
